text: しゃり　しゃり　いてだきのどうくつの　こおりを　けずって　つくった　かきごおり　つめたくて　うまい！

structure.jp: いてだきのどうくつの　こおりを　けずって　つくった　かきごおり
structure.en: shaved ice made by shaving ice from Icefall Cave

structure.jp: つめたくて　うまい！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: こおりを　けずって　つくった　かきごおり
patterns.explanation: The phrase ending in a verb describes the thing that comes after it. こおりを　けずって　つくった　かきごおり = 'shaved ice made by shaving ice'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: つめたくて　うまい
patterns.explanation: The て-form of a describing word joins it to the next one, like 'and'. つめたくて　うまい = 'cold and tasty'.
